modmenu.descriptionTranslation.pearhud: Shows the track currently playing in Pear Desktop on the Minecraft HUD, with album cover, scrolling title and a progress bar. The HUD tucks itself away on the side of the screen and slides back in on song changes, play/pause, or a key press.
modmenu.summaryTranslation.pearhud: Shows your Pear Desktop music in the HUD.
config.pearhud.title: Pear HUD
config.pearhud.enabled.desc: Turns the whole mod on or off.
config.pearhud.hideInDebug.desc: Hides the HUD while the F3 debug screen is open.
config.pearhud.autoHide.desc: On: the HUD slides off the screen when idle and comes back on song change, play/pause or key press. Off: always visible (the key toggles it).
config.pearhud.displaySeconds.desc: How long the HUD stays out after a trigger.
config.pearhud.rightSide.desc: On: the HUD docks to the right edge of the screen. Off: left edge.
config.pearhud.x.desc: Distance in pixels from the side the HUD is docked to.
config.pearhud.y.desc: Distance in pixels from the top of the screen.
config.pearhud.width.desc: Total width of the HUD in pixels.
config.pearhud.scrollSpeed.desc: Speed of long titles and artists, in pixels per second.
config.pearhud.host.desc: Address of the Pear Desktop API Server plugin (127.0.0.1 = this computer).
config.pearhud.port.desc: Port of the API Server plugin (26538 by default, HTTP).
config.pearhud.style.desc:
Full: cover, title, artist, time and progress bar. Compact: a single line. Minimal: text only, no background.

A live preview of the HUD is shown below.
config.pearhud.theme.desc:
Colors of the HUD. With the Custom theme, the accent color below is used. In the Minimal style only the accent color applies.

A live preview of the HUD is shown below.
config.pearhud.accentColor.desc:
Color of the side stripe, the progress bar and the cover placeholder. Only used with the Custom theme.

A live preview of the HUD is shown below.
config.pearhud.opacity.desc:
Transparency of the HUD background, in percent.

A live preview of the HUD is shown below.
